Definition: the heart (as the most interior organ);
BiblicalUsage: Heart is what lêbâb means — the inward place where love and loyalty live, and where God looks first. In Deuteronomy 6:5, "And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart"; and in Deuteronomy 30:6, "to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart". In 1 Kings 8:48, "And [so] return unto thee with all their heart"; and in Jeremiah 29:13, "when ye shall search for me with all your heart.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the heart is where everything is decided — love God with all of it, seek Him with all of it, and let Him circumcise it. I hold that no law can do what Moses promised: only God cuts away the hardness so we can love Him with all our heart. My position is that my heart is His work to do, and my work is to give it to Him without holding any of it back.
RelatedTopics: New heart; Love for God; Repentance
